title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:1
content: 1 Waƙar Waƙoƙin Solomon.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:2
content: 2 Bari yă sumbace ni da sumbar bakinsa, gama ƙaunarka ta fi ruwan inabi zaƙi.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:3
content: 3 Ƙanshin turarenka mai daɗi ne; sunanka kuwa kamar turaren da aka tsiyaye ne. Shi ya sa mata suke ƙaunarka!

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:4
content: 4 Ka ɗauke ni mu gudu, mu yi sauri! Bari sarki yă kai ni gidansa. Muna farin ciki muna kuma murna tare da kai, za mu yabi ƙaunarka fiye da ruwan inabi. Daidai ne su girmama ka!

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:5
content: 5 Ni baƙa ce, duk da haka kyakkyawa. Ya ku ’yan matan Urushalima, ni baƙa ce kamar tentunan Kedar, kamar labulen tentin Solomon.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:6
content: 6 Kada ku harare ni domin ni baƙa ce, gama rana ta dafa ni na yi baƙa. ’Ya’yan mahaifiyata maza sun yi fushi da ni suka sa ni aiki a gonakin inabi; na ƙyale gonar inabi na kaina.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:7
content: 7 Faɗa mini, kai da nake ƙauna, ina kake kiwon garkenka kuma ina kake kai tumakinka su huta da tsakar rana. Me ya sa zan kasance kamar macen da aka lulluɓe kusa da garkunan abokanka?

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:8
content: 8 Ke mafiya kyau a cikin mata, in ba ki sani ba, to, ki dai bi labin da tumaki suke bi ki yi kiwon ’yan awakinki kusa da tentunan makiyaya.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:9
content: 9 Ina kwatanta ke ƙaunatacciyata, da goɗiya mai jan keken yaƙin kayan Fir’auna.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:10
content: 10 ’Yan kunne sun ƙara wa kumatunki kyau, wuyanki yana da jerin kayan wuya masu daraja.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:11
content: 11 Za mu yi ’yan kunnenki na zinariya, da adon azurfa.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:12
content: 12 Yayinda sarki yake a teburinsa, turarena ya bazu da ƙanshi.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:13
content: 13 Ƙaunataccena yana kamar ƙanshin mur a gare ni, kwance a tsakanin ƙirjina.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:14
content: 14 Ƙaunataccena kamar tarin furanni jeji ne gare ni daga gonakin inabin En Gedi.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:15
content: 15 Ke kyakkyawa ce, ƙaunatacciyata! Kai, ke kyakkyawa ce! Idanunki kamar na kurciya ne.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:16
content: 16 Kai kyakkyawa ne, ƙaunataccena! Kai, kana ɗaukan hankali! Gadonmu koriyar ciyawa ce.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 1:17
content: 17 Al’ul su ne ginshiƙan gidanmu; fir su ne katakan rufin gidanmu.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:1
content: 1 Ni furen bi-rana ne na Sharon, furen bi-rana na kwari.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:2
content: 2 Kamar furen bi-rana a cikin ƙayayyuwa haka ƙaunatacciyata take a cikin ’yan mata.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:3
content: 3 Kamar itacen gawasa a cikin itatuwan jeji haka ƙaunataccena yake a cikin samari. Ina farin ciki in zauna a inuwarsa, ’ya’yan itacensa suna da daɗin ɗanɗanon da nake so

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:4
content: 4 Ya kai ni babban zauren da ake liyafa, ƙauna ita ce tutarsa a gare ni.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:5
content: 5 Ka ƙarfafa ni da zabibi ka wartsake ni da gawasa, gama ina suma don ƙauna.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:6
content: 6 Hannunsa na hagu yana a ƙarƙashin kaina, hannunsa na dama kuma ya rungume ni.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:7
content: 7 ’Yan matan Urushalima, ku yi mini alkawari da bareyi da ƙishimai na jeji. Ba za ku tā da ko ku farka ƙauna ba sai haka ya zama lalle.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:8
content: 8 Saurara! Ƙaunataccena! Duba! Ga shi ya iso, yana tsalle a duwatsu, yana rawa a bisa tuddai.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:9
content: 9 Ƙaunataccena yana kama da barewa ko sagarin ƙishimi Duba! Ga shi can tsaye a bayan katangarmu, yana leƙe ta tagogi, yana kallo ta cikin asabari.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:10
content: 10 Ƙaunataccena ya yi magana ya ce mini, “Tashi, ƙaunatacciyata, kyakkyawata, ki zo tare da ni.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:11
content: 11 Duba! Damina ta wuce; ruwan sama ya ɗauke ya kuma ƙare.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:12
content: 12 Furanni sun hudo a duniya; lokaci yin waƙa ya zo, ana jin kukan kurciyoyi ko’ina a ƙasarmu.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:13
content: 13 Itacen ɓaure ya fid da ’ya’yansa da sauri; tohon inabi suna ba da ƙanshinsu. Tashi, zo, ƙaunatacciyata; kyakkyawata, zo tare da ni.”

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:14
content: 14 Kurciyata a kogon dutse, a wuraren ɓuya a gefen dutse, nuna mini fuskarki, bari in ji muryarki; gama muryarki da daɗi take, fuskarki kuma kyakkyawa ce.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:15
content: 15 Kama mana ɓeraye, ƙananan ɓerayen da suke lalatar da gonakin inabi, gonakin inabinmu da suke cikin yin fure.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:16
content: 16 Ƙaunataccena nawa ne ni kuma tasa ce; yana kiwon garkensa a cikin furannin bi-rana.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 2:17
content: 17 Sai gari ya waye inuwa kuma ta watse, ka juye, ƙaunataccena, ka zama kamar barewa ko kamar sagarin ƙishimi a kan tuddai masu ciyawa.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:1
content: 1 Dare farai a kan gadona na nemi wanda zuciyata take ƙauna; na neme shi amma ban same shi ba.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:2
content: 2 Zan tashi yanzu in zagaya gari, in ratsa titunansa da dandalinsa; zan nemi wanda zuciyata take ƙauna. Saboda haka na neme shi, amma ban same shi ba.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:3
content: 3 Masu tsaro suka gamu da ni yayinda suke kai kawo a cikin birni, sai na ce, “Kun ga mini wanda zuciyata take ƙauna?”

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:4
content: 4 Rabuwata da su ke nan sai na sami wanda zuciyata take ƙauna. Na riƙe shi, ban yarda yă tafi ba sai da na kawo shi gidan mahaifiyata, zuwa ɗakin wadda ta yi cikina.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:5
content: 5 ’Yan matan Urushalima, ku yi mini alkawari da bareyi da ƙishimai na jeji. Ba za ku tā da ko ku farka ƙauna ba sai haka ya zama lalle.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:6
content: 6 Wane ne wannan mai zuwa daga hamada kamar tunnuƙewar hayaƙi, cike da ƙanshin turaren mur da lubban da aka yi da kayan yajin ’yan kasuwa?

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:7
content: 7 Duba! Abin ɗaukar Solomon ne, jarumawa sittin suke rakiya, zaɓaɓɓun sojojin Isra’ila,

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:8
content: 8 dukansu suna saye da takobi dukansu ƙwararru ne a yaƙi, kowanne da takobinsa a rataye a gefensa, a shirye don abubuwan bantsoro na dare.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:9
content: 9 Sarki Solomon ya yi wa kansa abin ɗauka; ya yi shi da katako daga Lebanon.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:10
content: 10 An yi sandunansa da azurfa, aka yi ƙasarsa da zinariya. An lulluɓe wurin zaman da zanen shunayya, ’yan matan Urushalima sun yi mata irin yayen da ake yi na ƙauna.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 3:11
content: 11 Fito, ku ’yan matan Sihiyona, ku ga Sarki Solomon yana saye da rawani, rawanin da mahaifiyarsa ta naɗa masa, a ranar aurensa, a ranar da zuciyarsa ta yi farin ciki.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:1
content: 1 Ke kyakkyawa ce, ƙaunatacciyata! Kai, ke kyakkyawa ce! Idanunki sun yi kamar na kurciya a cikin lulluɓinki. Gashinki ya yi kamar garken awaki da suke gangarawa daga Dutsen Gileyad.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:2
content: 2 Haƙoranki sun yi kamar garken tumakin da ba a daɗe da yin musu sausaya ba, da suke haurawa daga inda aka yi musu wanka. Kowanne yana tare da ɗan’uwansa; babu waninsu da yake shi kaɗai.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:3
content: 3 Leɓunanki kamar zaren jan garura bakinki yana da kyau. Kumatunki sun yi kamar rumman da aka tsaga biyu a cikin lulluɓinki.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:4
content: 4 Wuyanki ya yi kamar hasumiyar Dawuda, da aka gina da daraja; a kansa an rataye garkuwoyi dubu, dukansu garkuwoyin jarumawa ne.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:5
content: 5 Nonanki biyu sun yi kamar bareyi biyu, kamar tagwayen barewa da suke kiwo a cikin furen bi-rana.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:6
content: 6 Sai gari ya waye inuwa kuma ta watse, zan je dutsen mur da kuma tudun turare.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:7
content: 7 Duk, ke kyakkyawa ce, ƙaunatacciyata; babu wani lahani a cikinki.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:8
content: 8 Ki tare da ni daga Lebanon, amaryata, zo tare da ni daga Lebanon. Ki gangara daga ƙwanƙolin Amana, daga ƙwanƙolin Senir, ƙwanƙolin Hermon, daga ramin zaki da kuma dutsen da damisoshi suke zama.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:9
content: 9 Kin saci zuciyata, ’yar’uwata, amaryata; kin saci zuciyata da hararar idanunki, da dutse mai daraja guda na abin wuyanki.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:10
content: 10 Ƙaunarki abar farin ciki ne, ’yar’uwata, amaryata! Ƙaunarki ta fi ruwan inabi gamsuwa, ƙanshin turarenki kuma ya fi duk wani kayan yaji!

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:11
content: 11 Leɓunanki suna zub da zaƙi kamar kakin zuma, amaryata; madara da zuma suna a ƙarƙashin harshenki. Ƙanshin rigunanki ya yi kamar na Lebanon.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:12
content: 12 Ke lambu ne da aka kulle, ’yar’uwata, amaryata; ke maɓulɓula ce da aka kewaye, maɓulɓular da aka rufe.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:13
content: 13 Shuke-shukenki gonar rumman ne da ’ya’yan itace masu kyau na lalle da nardi,

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:14
content: 14 nardi, da asfaran, kalamus, da kirfa, da kowane irin itacen turare, da mur da aloyes da kuma dukan kayan yaji masu kyau.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:15
content: 15 Ke lambun maɓulɓula ne, rijiya mai ruwan da yake gudu yana gangarawa daga Lebanon.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 4:16
content: 16 Farka, iskar arewa, ki kuma zo, iskar kudu! Hura a kan lambuna, don ƙanshinsa yă bazu har waje. Bari ƙaunataccena yă zo cikin lambunsa yă ɗanɗana ’ya’yan itacensa mafi kyau.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:1
content: 1 Na zo lambuna, ’yar’uwata, amaryata; na tattara mur nawa da kayan yajina. Na sha zumana da kuma kakinsa na sha ruwan inabina da kuma madarana. Ku ci, ku kuma sha, ya ku ƙawaye; ku sha ku ƙoshi, ya ƙaunatattu.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:2
content: 2 Na yi barci amma zuciyata tana a farke. Ku saurara! Ƙaunataccena yana ƙwanƙwasa ƙofa. “Buɗe mini, ’yar’uwata, ƙaunatacciyata, kurciyata, marar laifina. Kaina ya jiƙe da raɓa, gashina ya yi danshin ɗiɗɗigar dare.”

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:3
content: 3 Na tuɓe rigata, sai in sāke sa ta kuma? Na wanke ƙafafuna, sai in sāke ɓata su?

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:4
content: 4 Ƙaunataccena ya turo hannunsa ta cikin ramin ƙofar; zuciyata ta fara juyayi a kansa.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:5
content: 5 Na tashi don in buɗe wa ƙaunataccena, sai hannuna ya jiƙe sharkaf da mur, yatsotsina suna ɗiga da mur, a hannuwan ƙofar.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:6
content: 6 Na buɗe wa ƙaunataccena ƙofa, amma ƙaunataccena ba ya nan, ya riga ya tafi. Zuciyata ta damu da tafiyarsa. Na neme shi amma ban same shi ba. Na yi ta kiransa amma bai amsa ba.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:7
content: 7 Masu gadi suka gamu da ni yayinda suke kai kawo a cikin birni. Suka yi mini dūka, suka yi mini rauni; suka ƙwace gyalena waɗannan masu gadin katanga!

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:8
content: 8 ’Yan matan Urushalima, ina roƙonku, in kun sami ƙaunataccena me za ku ce masa? Ku ce masa na suma saboda ƙauna.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:9
content: 9 Mafiya kyau a cikin mata me ya sa ƙaunataccenki ya fi sauran? Don me kike roƙonmu mu faɗa masa yadda kike ji?

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:10
content: 10 Ƙaunataccena kyakkyawa ne ƙaƙƙarfa kuma, da ƙyar a sami irinsa ɗaya a cikin dubu goma.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:11
content: 11 Kansa zinariya ce zalla; gashinsa dogaye ne baƙi wuluk kamar hankaka.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:12
content: 12 Idanunsa sun yi kamar na kurciyoyin da suke kusa da ruwan rafi, da aka wanke da madara aka kuma kafa kamar kayan ado masu daraja.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:13
content: 13 Kumatunsa kamar lambun kayan yaji suna ba da turare. Leɓunansa sun yi kamar furen bi-rana suna ɗiga da mur.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:14
content: 14 Hannuwansa kamar sandunan zinariyar da aka sa musu duwatsu masu daraja. Jikinsa ya yi kamar gogaggen hauren giwan da aka yi masa ado da duwatsun saffaya.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:15
content: 15 Ƙafafunsa sun yi kamar ginshiƙan dutsen alabastar da aka kafa su a cikin rammukar zinariya. Kamanninsa ya yi kamar Lebanon, mafi kyau kamar itacen al’ul nasa.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 5:16
content: 16 Bakinsa zaƙi ne kansa; komensa yana da kyau. Haka ƙaunataccena, abokina, yake ’yan matan Urushalima.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:1
content: 1 Ina ƙaunataccenki ya tafi, yake mafiya kyau cikin mata? Wace hanya ce ƙaunataccenki ya bi, don mu taimake ki nemansa.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:2
content: 2 Ƙaunataccena ya gangara zuwa lambunsa, zuwa inda fangulan kayan yaji suke, don yă yi kiwo a cikin lambun don kuma yă tattara furen bi-rana.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:3
content: 3 Ni na ƙaunataccena ce, ƙaunataccena kuma nawa ne; yana kiwo a cikin furen bi-rana.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:4
content: 4 Ke kyakkyawa ce, ƙaunatacciyata, kamar Tirza, kyakkyawa kuma kamar Urushalima, mai daraja kamar mayaƙa da tutoti.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:5
content: 5 Ki kau da idanu daga gare ni; gama suna rinjayata. Gashinki yana kama da garken awakin da suke gangarawa daga Gileyad.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:6
content: 6 Haƙoranki suna kama da garken tumakin da suke haurawa daga inda aka yi musu wanka. Kowanne yana tare da ɗan’uwansa; babu waninsu da yake shi kaɗai.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:7
content: 7 Kumatunki sun yi kamar rumman da aka tsaga biyu a cikin lulluɓinki.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:8
content: 8 Sarauniyoyi sittin za su iya kasance a can, da ƙwarƙwarai tamanin da kuma budurwai da suka wuce ƙirge;

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:9
content: 9 amma kurciyata, cikakkiyata, dabam take, tilo kuwa ga mahaifiyarta, ’yar lele ga wadda ta haife ta. ’Yan mata sun gan ta suka ce da ita mai albarka; sarauniyoyi da ƙwarƙwarai sun yabe ta.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:10
content: 10 Wace ce wannan da ta bayyana sai ka ce ketowar alfijir? Kyakkyawa kamar wata, mai haske kamar rana, mai daraja kamar taurari a jere?

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:11
content: 11 Na gangara zuwa cikin itatuwan almon don in ga ƙananan itatuwan da suke girma a kwari, don in ga ko inabi sun yi ’ya’ya ko rumman suna fid da furanni.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:12
content: 12 Kafin in san wani abu, sha’awarta ta sa ni a cikin keken yaƙin sarkin mutanena.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 6:13
content: 13 Ki dawo, ki dawo, ya Bashulammiya; ki dawo, ki dawo, don mu dube ki! Don me kuke duban Bashulammiya sai ka ce rawar Mahanayim?

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:1
content: 1 Ƙafafunki a cikin takalma kyakkyawa ne, Ya diyar sarki! Tsarin ƙafafunki sun yi kamar kayan ado masu daraja, aikin hannun gwanin sassaƙa.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:2
content: 2 Cibinki kamar kwaf ne da bai taɓa rasa gaurayayyen ruwan inabi ba. Kwankwasonki ya yi kamar damin alkama wanda furen bi-rana ya kewaye.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:3
content: 3 Nonanki sun yi kamar bareyi biyu, tagwayen barewa.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:4
content: 4 Wuyanki ya yi kamar hasumiyar hauren giwa. Idanunki sun yi kamar tafkin Heshbon kusa da ƙofar Bat Rabbim. Hancinki ya yi kamar hasumiyar Lebanon wadda take duban Damaskus.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:5
content: 5 Kanki ya yi miki rawani kamar Dutsen Karmel. Gashinki ya yi kamar shunayya; yakan ɗauke hankalin sarki.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:6
content: 6 Kai! Ke kyakkyawa ce kuma kina sa ni jin daɗi, Ya ƙaunatacciya, da farin cikin da kike kawo!

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:7
content: 7 Tsayinki ya yi kamar itacen dabino, kuma nonanki sun yi kamar ’ya’yan itace.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:8
content: 8 Na ce, “Zan hau itacen dabino; zan kama ’ya’yansa.” Bari nonanki su zama kamar nonna kuringa, ƙanshin numfashinki ya yi kamar gawasa,

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:9
content: 9 kuma bakinki ya yi kamar ruwan inabi mafi kyau. Bari ruwan inabi yă wuce kai tsaye zuwa ga ƙaunataccena, yana gudu a hankali a leɓuna da kuma haƙora.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:10
content: 10 Ni ta ƙaunataccena ce, kuma sha’awarsa domina ne.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:11
content: 11 Ka zo, ƙaunataccena, bari mu je bayan gari, bari mu kwana a ƙauye.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:12
content: 12 Bari mu tafi gonar inabi da sassafe don mu ga ko kuringar ta yi ’ya’ya, ko furanninsu sun buɗe, ko rumman sun yi fure, a can zan nuna maka ƙaunata.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 7:13
content: 13 Manta-uwa sun ba da ƙanshinsu, a bakin ƙofa kuwa akwai kowane abinci mai daɗi, sabo da tsoho, da na ajiye dominka, ƙaunataccena.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:1
content: 1 Da a ce kai ɗan’uwa ne gare ni, wanda nonon mahaifiyata sun shayar! Da in na same ka a waje, na sumbace ka, babu wanda zai rena ni.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:2
content: 2 Da sai in bi da kai in kawo ka gidan mahaifiyata, ita da ta koyar da ni. Da na ba ka ruwan inabi gaurayayye da kayan yaji ka sha, zaƙin rumman nawa.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:3
content: 3 Hannunsa na hagu yana a ƙarƙashin kaina, hannunsa na dama kuma ya rungume ni.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:4
content: 4 ’Yan matan Urushalima, ku yi mini alkawari. Ba za ku tā da ko ku farka ƙauna ba sai haka ya zama lalle.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:5
content: 5 Wace ce wannan da take haurawa daga hamada tana dogara a kan ƙaunataccenta? A ƙarƙashin itacen gawasa na farkar da ke, a wurin da aka haife ki, wurin da mahaifiyarki ta haife ki.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:6
content: 6 Ka sa ni kamar hatimi a zuciyarka, kamar hatimi a hannunka; gama ƙauna tana da ƙarfi kamar mutuwa, kishinta yana kamar muguntar kabari, yana ƙuna kamar wuta mai ci, kamar gagarumar wuta.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:7
content: 7 Ruwa da yawa ba zai iya kashe ƙauna ba, koguna ba za su iya kwashe ta ba. In wani zai bayar da dukan dukiyar gidansa don ƙauna, za a yi masa dariya ne kawai.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:8
content: 8 Muna da ƙanuwa, nonanta ba su riga sun yi girma ba. Me za mu yi da ƙanuwarmu a ranar da za a yi maganar sonta?

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:9
content: 9 Da a ce ita katanga ce, da sai mu gina hasumiyar azurfa a kanta. Da a ce ita ƙofa ce, da sai mun yi mata ƙyauren itacen al’ul.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:10
content: 10 Ni katanga ce kuma nonaina sun yi kamar hasumiya. Ta haka na zama idanunsa kamar wanda yake kawo gamsuwa.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:11
content: 11 Solomon ya kasance da gonar inabi a Ba’al-Hamon; ya ba da hayar gonar inabi ga ’yan haya. Kowanne zai biya shekel dubu na azurfa don ’ya’yan inabin.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:12
content: 12 Amma gonar inabina nawa ne da zan bayar; shekel dubu naka ne, ya Solomon, kuma ɗari biyu na waɗanda suke lura da ’ya’yan itatuwansa ne.

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:13
content: 13 Ke da kike zaune a cikin lambu da ƙawaye suna lura da ke, bari in ji muryarki!

title: Waƙar Waƙoƙi 8:14
content: 14 Ka zo, ƙaunataccena, ka zama kamar barewa ko kuwa kamar ’yar batsiya a kan dutsen da kayan yaji suke a shimfiɗe.
